sources.title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
reading_scope: Section 3.1 environment state and user-task checking
sources.claim_scope: Separates benign utility, utility under attack and attack success, using task/state evaluation in a tool environment.
sources.need_inferred: 资料可用于事实判断，但不能自行赋予执行新动作的授权。
sources.minimal_feature_proposed: Retain source trust metadata at tool-action boundaries and check unauthorized effects separately from legitimate task utility.
sources.limits: Historical models, synthetic applications and attacks do not establish current OpenDot safety; finite passed cases cannot prove general prompt-injection immunity. No attack was run.

sources.title: τ-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
sources.claim_scope: Paper distinguishes at-least-one success from all-k success, and explicitly says matching final state may still miss an unconfirmed action violating policy.
sources.need_inferred: 终态、请求完整性、过程授权和重复运行稳定性要分别可审查。
sources.minimal_feature_proposed: Separate result and process-rule verdicts; retain every repeated trial and forbid a passing outcome from masking a policy failure.
sources.limits: Our proposed process-rule oracle addresses a caveat stated in the paper; it is not a claim that the original benchmark already enforces every policy. Simulated users and old model scores are not real demand or current performance.
